note: Per-mini listener-gate settings, read by scripts/glaeda-cmux-runner-hook from the release glaeda-update installed (docs/CMUX_MINI_RUNNER.md, 'Per-mini gate settings'). Keys under hosts are the short, lowercased hostname (hostname -s), not the manifest member name. cpuHold false: the CPU marks (85/80 over 60 s) never hold that mini's listeners; units, memory pressure, heat, disk and the fleet's holds still do. A host entry with an until (UTC) is ignored past it, so a trial ends by itself.
